name: Genpet

sites.name: Genpet
sites.notes: BigCommerce + Makeswift page builder store for Genpet.

performance.note: PageSpeed Insights, median of 3. Measurements are stored for trend analysis; reports show the Before/After scores supplied in the prompt.

security.note: Chrome DevTools/CDP: security headers, cookies, SRI, console errors, vulnerable libraries. The authenticated pass runs only when STOREFRONT_USERNAME/STOREFRONT_PASSWORD are set.

seo.note: Sitemap + crawl, canonical/robots/structured data, GEO/AEO readiness, multi-viewport layout.

ai-crawlers.note: Derived from the seo crawl (robots.txt rules for GPTBot, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity ...).

network.note: Availability + response time (UptimeRobot when UPTIMEROBOT_API_KEY is set, live probe otherwise).

functional.reason: No generic storefront-journey runner exists yet (see docs/LIMITATIONS.md).

companion-app.note: app.genpet.org dashboard (read-only nav pass, write-request guardrail). POST /api/users/singleUser is a known unresolved guardrail trip; do NOT whitelist without explicit sign-off.

cache.reason: Server/build-cache metrics are captured manually from the hosting dashboard; no API runner exists yet.

secrets.purpose: UptimeRobot read-only API key (30-day availability); optional - a live probe is used without it
Storefront customer login for the authenticated security pass; optional
Storefront customer password for the authenticated security pass; optional

inputs.notes: Scores are Before/After per page and viewport, for example Homepage and About Us.

context: Single BigCommerce storefront (genpet.org) with the app.genpet.org companion dashboard (authenticated, read-only). Performance Before/After scores are supplied manually in every prompt.
